english: Let $S$ be the set of all $x\in(0,2\pi)$, $x\ne\pi$, satisfying the equation $4\sin x-3\cos x-3=\tan\dfrac{x}{2}$. Then the value of $\displaystyle\sum_{x\in S}\sin x$ is ______.
hindi: माना कि $S$ उन सभी $x\in(0,2\pi)$, $x\ne\pi$, का समुच्चय है जो समीकरण $4\sin x-3\cos x-3=\tan\dfrac{x}{2}$ को सन्तुष्ट करते हैं। तब $\displaystyle\sum_{x\in S}\sin x$ का मान ______ है।
solution: Put $t=\tan\frac x2$: $\sin x=\frac{2t}{1+t^2}$, $\cos x=\frac{1-t^2}{1+t^2}$; for $x\in(0,2\pi)\setminus\{\pi\}$, $t$ takes each real value once
solution_full: Let $t=\tan\frac x2$. As $x$ runs over $(0,2\pi)$ with $x\ne\pi$, $\frac x2$ runs over $(0,\pi)$ with $\frac x2\ne\frac{\pi}{2}$, and $t$ takes every real value exactly once.
Substitute $\sin x=\frac{2t}{1+t^2}$ and $\cos x=\frac{1-t^2}{1+t^2}$ and multiply by $1+t^2>0$:
$t=1$ is a root; dividing, $t^3-7t+6=(t-1)(t^2+t-6)=(t-1)(t-2)(t+3)$. So $t\in\{1,2,-3\}$, giving three distinct $x$ in $S$.
originality_note: New: an a sin x + b cos x + c = tan(x/2) equation whose half-angle substitution gives the cubic t^3 - 7t + 6 = 0 with three rational roots, then the answer is read back through sin x = 2t/(1+t^2) (way 5). Closest known: 3 sin x + 4 cos x = 5 with t = tan(x/2) (a quadratic). Different because: the tan(x/2) on the right turns the problem into a cubic with three roots.

concept_use.Solution by substitution: The whole equation is rewritten in the single unknown t and solved as the polynomial t^3 - 7t + 6 = 0, then back-substituted.
concept_use.Half-angle substitution t = tan(x/2): sin x = 2t/(1+t^2), cos x = (1-t^2)/(1+t^2) with t = tan(x/2); the excluded point x = pi is where t is undefined.
